# Goreview

> Goreview makes customized NFC and QR Google review cards for businesses in the Philippines.

Goreview helps a business give customers a direct, voluntary path to its Google review page. Customers can tap an NFC-enabled phone or scan a QR code; they do not need to search for the business listing first.

## Important facts

- Product: customized NFC and QR Google review cards.
- Price: from PHP 699 with a one-time payment.
- Support: lifetime support is included.
- Coverage: cards are made for businesses in the Philippines and can ship across the Philippines.
- Review policy: Goreview does not filter feedback, require a positive rating, offer incentives for reviews, or guarantee review volume, ratings, or search rankings.
- Brand relationship: Goreview is an independent product by Helbi Solutions and is not affiliated with Google.

## Canonical pages

- [Google review cards](https://goreview.rald.site/google-review-card): what a Google review card is and how NFC and QR work together.
- [NFC Google review cards](https://goreview.rald.site/nfc-google-review-card): how tap-to-review cards work and when QR is useful as a fallback.
- [Google review QR code cards](https://goreview.rald.site/google-review-qr-code): how a QR code sends customers to a business review page.
- [Google review cards in the Philippines](https://goreview.rald.site/google-review-card-philippines): local ordering, setup, shipping, and support information.
